# SEO 50 — Search intent inventory (stage 23)

Snapshot: 2026-11-17. Local static pages only. This is an editorial inventory, not ranking data or verified search volume.

## Decisions

- Homepage: personal-name and professional-brand navigation. About: biography and professional background. Resume: CV and downloadable professional history. Portfolio: products and case studies. Product management guide: educational explanation. These roles are distinct even when they share the person’s name or job title.
- Blog home: browse journal; interview series: practice for product-manager interviews; design/UX category: explore design decisions; tags: browse a narrower topic.
- Articles: focus on their specific product problem, not the generic interview-series phrase.
- Page 2+ is a continuation, not a separate primary topic. Translations are not compared as conflicting pages.
- Persian tags تحقیق کاربر (4 articles) and پژوهش کاربر (3 articles) share a concept. Preferred editorial term: پژوهش کاربر. Retain existing routes and indexability pending Google Search Console evidence and a migration review. No automatic redirect, deletion, or canonical change.

## Verification with Google Search Console (pending)

Use Performance > Search results, Web, last 3 months. Filter an exact query or a narrow group of related queries, then inspect the Pages tab. Compare impressions, clicks, CTR and position by URL and across time windows. Review user intent and whether any URL switching is harmful before consolidation. Two pages appearing for a query alone is not proof of harmful cannibalization. Export query and page dimensions together if using the authorized Search Console API; separate unjoined lists are insufficient.
